name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

retryGapPercent.title: Retry gap (percentage points)
retryGapPercent.description: After an automatic compaction leaves the context at or above the compaction percentage, wait until it has grown by this many points before trying again.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated reduction (0.25 = 25%) for a compaction to replace the history; below it the compaction is skipped.

builtinFallback.title: Fall back to the built-in summary
builtinFallback.description: When on, the main conversation gets Claude Code's built-in summary whenever Jev fails or saves less than the minimum, instead of being left unchanged.

logFile.title: Compaction log file
logFile.description: Where the last 10 compaction results are written, one JSON line each. Empty uses ~/.claude/fast-jev-compaction-log.jsonl; off turns the log off.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

pinnedTools.title: Tools always kept
pinnedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names whose calls and results are never compacted. Defaults to the tools that start, message or stop helper agents, whose results carry the ids needed to reach them later. Leave empty to pin none.
